body:
This fix does not appear to work in all cases.

E.g. try running HttpTest.testListenInvalidPort() in the Vert.x 3.0 test suite

I believe in the case that the bind fails, the event gets delivered on a global executor thread not the event loop.

Suggestion: Run the Vert.x 3.0 test suite after fixing - if you see any warnings like:
WARNING: io.vertx.core.logging.impl.JULLogDelegate warn - Expected to be on Vert.x thread, but actually on: Thread[globalEventExecutor-1-1,5,main]

It means it's not fixed ;)
@purplefox I think it is now fixed.. Also added another test case. Thanks for reporting!

Do you know when this fix will be available in a release?

I am using Netty 4.0.21.final now and the problem is still there.

Hopefully within one week.
